name: ml-grilling
description: Design interviews that respect the person's attention. questions decides which questions to ask at all (only ones whose answer changes the outcome; standard practice, look-up facts and routine choices are settled and shown in one line) and how to word them: plain words, two-line bodies, one-line options, a short honest recommendation. grill-with-ui runs the interview on a browser page instead of the terminal — every question laid out with its recommendation, answerable in any order, with a discussion thread and one Send button — vendored from jasonku09/grill-with-ui (MIT) with one addition: on a remote machine it serves on the Tailscale address and opens the page in your Mac's browser, set once per machine in agent-config (remote.enabled, remote.host, remote.open). A hook adds the questions rules to the context whenever /grilling, /grill-me, /grill-with-docs, /grill-with-ui or /wayfinder starts, typed or called by Claude (needs bun).
